title: Income Tax Act
source_id: C.S.Nu., c.I-20 (originating as R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c.I-1, duplicated for Nunavut)
verified_how: Register page 'INCOME TAX ACT, Official Consolidation of', listed under I, with legal notice last updated 01 June 2026. The notice PDF (NoticeCSNucI20.pdf) is headed 'Income Tax Act / C.S.Nu.,c.I-20 / Notice under subsection 65(2) of the Legislation Act' and records changes 'made in the September 18, 2025 consolidation'. The consolidation PDF's cover prints 'OFFICIAL CONSOLIDATION OF INCOME TAX ACT / C.S.Nu.,c.I-20 / (Consolidation date: September 18, 2025) / R.S.N.W.T. 1988,c.I-1'. In force; not repealed. Currency caveat on the Act's page: 'This consolidation is not up to date. See subsequent amendments: S.Nu. 2026,c.8.'
notes: This is the territorial income tax Act, named as required. Carried-over NWT statute: the Northwest Territories Income Tax Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c.I-1, duplicated for Nunavut and since amended by the Nunavut Legislature, now consolidated as C.S.Nu., c.I-20. Nunavut personal income tax is levied under it and collected by the Canada Revenue Agency under a federal-territorial collection agreement; the register separately lists an Income Tax Collection Agreement Questions Act. Computation of income and source withholding themselves are federal (Income Tax Act, R.S.C. 1985, c. 1 (5th Supp.)). Nunavut also levies a payroll tax on remuneration earned in the territory under the Payroll Tax Act, listed separately on the same register as an unofficial consolidation.
